Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the task was complete with an answer of 2 studio albums, failing to recognize that "Cantora 1" and "Cantora 2" are separate albums. Both are listed individually in the Studio Albums section on the Wikipedia page, and should have been counted separately as two distinct albums from 2009. This oversight led to the incorrect final count of 2 albums instead of the correct count of 3 albums.
